description.p: rbx-native is a Roblox Studio replacement written from scratch in Rust. It reads and writes place and model files (binary and XML), renders them on the GPU, runs Luau, talks to Open Cloud, and tries to look and feel as close to Studio as it can.

ul.li: Explorer, Properties and a 3D viewport with move, scale and rotate tools
A Luau script editor with Script Analysis, autocomplete and a debugger
Terrain, GUI, animation and material editing
Publishing, version history, DataStores and game settings through Open Cloud
Playtesting in the Sober client, and Argon and Loren for syncing with your own tools

description.p: The Flatpak build can't run programs on the host, so the network simulator, the controller emulator and launching Sober with a simulated device aren't in it. The app says so where they would be.
This is an unofficial community project. It isn't affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation, and "Roblox" is their trademark.
